parties.respondent: Telangana State Electricity Regulatory Commission & Anr.

summary: SEZ developer's deemed distribution licensee status challenge; applicability of capital adequacy rules; 2010 Notification conferring deemed license status; statutory interpretation of Electricity Act sections 14(b), 16, proviso to section 14(b); hierarchy between SEZ Act and Electricity Act regulations; TSERC/APTEL upheld requirement for 30% equity infusion (Rs.26.90 crore) pre-identification; Court found regulations 12/13 distinguish general applicants from deemed licensees; rule 3(2) of 2005 Rules not mandatory for deemed status; dismissal of appeal upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Electricity Act, 2003 s.14(b), proviso to s.14(b), s.16, s.2(62), s.125
Special Economic Zones Act, 2005 s.3, s.4, s.49
Andhra Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Distribution Licence) Regulations, 2013 regulation 12, 13, Schedule-2
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; TSERC direction for equity infusion set aside; deemed licensee status recognized without mandatory compliance with rule 3 of 2005 Rules.
